title: The demo autopilot (a player surrogate — orchestration concern) is implemented inside the pure sim package core, and its header falsely claims the game doesn't use it
detail: §4 layering puts the simulation in core and player/input surrogates in orchestration; testkit.odin is a scripted player driving edits that the GAME app calls (autopilot). It ships in package core, and the stale '(NOT used by the game)' comment invites agents to treat it as test-only when app behavior depends on it.
recommended_fix: Move the autopilot to app/run (it only uses exported core procs) or keep it in core deliberately and fix the header comment to name the app autopilot dependency.

title: The six-file #load catalog source list is duplicated between core testkit and the app loader — two lists to keep in sync
detail: test_catalog_sources (core) and embedded_sources (app/run) enumerate the same six catalog files independently. Adding a seventh catalog to one and not the other would compile fine while tests/harness and the game silently load different data — the dual-source-of-truth shape §14.4 eliminated.
recommended_fix: Keep the canonical #load list in one place (e.g. embedded_sources in core, since core already owns Catalog_Sources) and have the app's dev-disk overlay read from it.
